notes.value: Deepal S05 REEV, a range-extended EV: the wheels are driven only by the rear electric motor and the 1.5-litre (1,497 cc) Blue Whale engine (70 kW / 94 hp, 122 Nm) acts as a generator. Per the Deepal Pakistan brochure and deepal.com.pk: 27.28 kWh CATL Golden Shield LFP battery, 160 kW / 215 hp, 320 Nm, RWD, 170 km electric range (NEDC) and 1,000+ km combined from a 44.9 L tank. AC 6.6 kW, DC 54.5 kW with 30–80% in 20 minutes; V2L up to 6.6 kW. 4,620×1,900×1,600 mm, wheelbase 2,880 mm, ground clearance 169 mm, 492 L boot, 18-inch wheels on 225/60 R18, drag coefficient 0.25. 5 seats, 6 airbags, full ADAS, 15.4-inch touchscreen, head-up display, 14 speakers, panoramic roof, wireless CarPlay and Android Auto. Warranty: battery 8 years / 240,000 km, vehicle 5 years / 150,000 km. Top speed (170 km/h) and 0–100 are not in the official material. Real-world electric range is nearer 110–130 km. PKR 9,999,000. Sold by Master Changan.
